title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per shitje tek Oxhaku, Kompleksi Kolombo
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 prane Kompleksit Kolombo .
Ndodhet ne katin e 7 dhe sapo eshte rinovuar.
Ndodhet buze rruge dhe ka fasileteti prane si supermarkete, institucione financiare.
Sapo eshte investuar dhe shitet e pamobiluar.
Disponon dhe post parkimi 15 metra me cmim ekstra.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at Oxhaku, Colombo Complex
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale near the Colombo Complex. It is located on the 7th floor and has just been renovated. It is located on the side of the road and there are facilities nearby such as supermarkets, financial institutions. It has just been invested and is being sold unfurnished. There is also a 15-meter parking post at an extra cost.
